product.name: Monoprice 4-pole NL4 Female Speaker Twist Connector
product.description: Monoprice is your greatest source for high-performance, high-quality NL4 speaker cable connectors!Build or repair your own speaker cables to suit your needs with this 4-pole NL4 Female Connector. It accepts speaker wire up to 10 AWG and features a spring-loaded lock release latch. The connector is constructed of a high impact material for long-term durability and uses a strain relief system to ensure your custom cabling stays put.
